name: Anu LMS Quizzes
description: Extends Anu LMS with quiz functionality: quiz nodes, question/result entities, submission REST endpoints and teacher result pages.
project_description: Submodule of Anu LMS. Adds quiz (assessment) functionality: a module_assessment node type, assessment_question / assessment_question_result / assessment_result content entities with per-type bundles (single/multiple choice, scale, short/long answer), two cookie-authenticated REST endpoints for submitting single questions and whole quizzes, automatic grading, optional 'hide correct answers' and 'prevent multiple submissions' controls, and teacher-facing result review pages with XLS export via Views Data Export.
